# Deck Builder

> Stage-gated production of a proposal/sales deck from a brief to a finished deck, with a one-message gate up front and an accumulating polish-review loop at the end.

**What it does.** Stage-gated production of a multi-slide proposal, pitch, or sales deck from a brief to a finished deck: a one-message gate up front to lock the argument, then an accumulating polish-review loop at the end.

**Use it when.** Building a multi-slide deck and you want discipline plus a self-improving final QA pass. Defers all brand, color, and visual decisions to brand-renderer and the final copy pass to prose-pass.

**Not for.** Do NOT use for the specific Aleysian Deal Decision deck presented before the proposal (that is ddoc) or an interactive HTML proposal page (that is interactive-proposal).
